sample_unit: paired rater assessments (20 synthetic claims x 10 rubric dimensions)

links.outcome: Inter-rater agreement and rater scoring asymmetry when clinical reviewers scored LLM output
links.effect: Overall quadratic weighted kappa was 0.53; one reviewer scored consistently lower; 30-40% of items diverged by two or more points on Missing Information, Contextual Understanding, and Hallucination.
links.quote: Rater analysis revealed a systematic asymmetry in adjudication, with one reviewer scoring consistently lower.

unlisted_practices: Calibration exercises for raters before formal validation scoring

screen.reason: Empirical validation study assessing the performance and inter-rater reliability of an LLM pipeline extracting actuarial variables from synthetic clinical claims documents.
